response.overview: Surfing (2025) is a drama short written by Harry Clarke and directed by Duane Adamoli. Set in Birmingham, 1969, it follows Pete, a broke, hungover singer-songwriter crashing on a friend's sofa, handed a last-minute gig offer meant for someone else as his career and love life quietly fall apart. A restless portrait of desperation, ambition, and the small compromises we make to stay afloat.
response.tagline: Three calls. One sofa. Nowhere left to go.
response.title: Surfing
